description: Institutions link monitoring rights public finance participation and implementation for safe and just transformation.
Governance improves climate performance but must address material rebound and justice.
Technology pathways need precaution chemical control material realism and accountability.
Weak coordination and uneven capacity produce unequal adaptation and crisis response.
Low capacity systems allow extraction overshoot inequality and delayed reaction.
Regional institutions coordinate restoration food water energy land and infrastructure resilience.
International cooperation strengthens planetary commons governance and implementation capacity.
Adaptation governance prioritizes vulnerable communities social foundations and rights protections.
